plugin.name: Image Preview
plugin.description:
**Image Preview** is a free, open-source (MIT) Tavo plugin for working with images and GIFs without leaving your chat.

- Preview image, GIF or web page links, and pin up to 30 of them over the chat
- Save images (with a Recycle Bin), import from your device, and find every picture in a pasted text or in the whole chat
- Character page: read the open card as one scrollable page with its pictures
- Quick Lookup (translate, define, search) and a small game corner
- Storage manager: see what Image Preview keeps on your phone and clean it up safely

Private by design: no accounts, no tracking, nothing sent to the author. Everything stays on your device and goes online only when you ask. Available in English and Bengali. You agree to a short, friendly Terms of Use once. Needs Advanced Rendering. Full guide: the ? Help button inside the panel.

Source code (MIT License): https://github.com/mrsae123/Image-Preview-

runtime.helpS1B: Paste an image link or a webpage link, then tap Preview. Pin on chat keeps it floating over the chat so you can look at it while you type. Drag to move, pinch or use +/- to resize. The pin's toolbar also has reset, rotate, flip, fullscreen and remove; tap ︿ to fold the toolbar away. Clear all next to "Pinned on chat" unpins everything at once — it only unpins them, nothing is deleted. If the floating button ends up stuck off-screen, use "Reset floating button position" in the chat's right sidebar (Plugin · Image Preview) to bring it back. You can pin up to 30 images at once; remove one to pin another. Only images, GIFs and web pages are ever fetched.
runtime.helpExtractB: Got a big pasted character card or post full of pictures? Paste the whole thing into the chat input, then tap "Extract images from text" in the + menu — it quietly ignores all the text and hands you just the images and GIFs to look through. Everything starts checked; tap any tile you don't want to leave it out, then Save selected (or just Save all) tucks them into Saved Previews. Want a few of them floating on the chat too? Head to Saved Previews afterward and use Select. You can also skip the pasting: tap "Scan this chat for images" in the panel (or in the right sidebar) and it searches the whole chat for you — the character card, persona, lorebooks and every message, newest first. Tap Rescan chat any time after the chat changes and it tells you what's new. Images you've already saved are marked Saved and skipped. Scanning only reads the chat on your device; the pictures themselves load from their original links. Links to videos, music, archives, apps or other files are ignored.
runtime.helpS2B: Save preview keeps a copy for this chat, and every pinned image is saved automatically too. Tap Select above the saved grid to pick a few and Pin selected — handy right after Extract images from text, or anytime you just fancy a couple back on the chat. Tap any saved image normally for Fullscreen, Pin, Save to device, Copy link, Rename, Info and Delete. Rename only changes the label; the image itself is never touched. Deleting one — or using Clear all — doesn't erase it right away either; see Recycle Bin below. The saved grid shows 200 images at a time; tap Show more at its end for the rest.
runtime.helpRecycleB: Nothing's gone the moment you delete it. Deleted saved images rest in the Recycle Bin first — 7 or 30 days, whichever you've picked under Settings — so a stray tap on Clear all is never the end of the world. Open it anytime from "Open Recycle Bin" in the chat's right sidebar, tick whatever you want, then Restore (it lands in the chat you have open) or Delete forever if you're sure. Anything you never touch quietly clears itself out once its own time is up.
runtime.helpThemeB: See the little monkey munching a banana next to the title? Poke him — he gets grumpy, then opens the look options: a wallpaper from your phone (or an image link), how dark it is, a nature-inspired panel background like Forest or Aurora, the panel font, and your floating button's icon and color. Everything applies right away, and "Back to defaults" undoes your changes. The same window also has a text size slider and background motion (Static by default).

runtime.helpS3B: The ⚓ hangs on a rope and sways by itself. Pull it down to open Translate, Meaning and Web Search. To close, tap the ⚓ or pull it down again. A tap on the closed anchor only gives the rope a tug.
runtime.helpS4B: Tap 🎮 for a Jump Game, Snake and Memory Bomb, or add your own game. Drag the top bar to move the window and the corner to resize it. The ⚙ button inside a game holds your player name and that game's own settings and resets.
runtime.helpS5B: Saved images and pins belong only to this chat — the one exception is the Recycle Bin, which holds deleted images across every chat until they're restored or their time runs out. Built-in games are fully offline. Games you add yourself run in an isolated box and cannot read your chats or Tavo data. Privacy Mode blocks every lookup request. Nothing is collected or sent to the author. Only images, GIFs and web pages are meant to be downloaded: links to videos, apps, archives and other files are refused before anything is fetched, and a download that turns out not to be a picture is deleted right away. You can read the Terms of Use again below.

runtime.helpPageB: Open it from the panel, or from "Character page" in the chat's right sidebar (Plugin · Image Preview). It reads the open chat's card (creator notes, description, personality and scenario) and shows it as one scrollable page, with the pictures and GIFs where the card put them, a bit like a bot's intro page. Tap a picture to see it bigger. In a group chat, tap a name at the top to switch characters. Centered text, text sizes, bold, italic and bright colours are kept; backgrounds are not. Links show as small pills that open Page view, while promo banners, invite links and scraper stamps are left out (tap Show all to see everything). It is read on your device, and the pictures load from their original links only when you open the page. Opening it from the panel closes the panel; tap the floating button to bring the panel back.

If a link won't preview, it may not be an image, GIF or web page, or the site may block outside apps.

runtime.helpWebB: Links on the Character page show up as small pills. Tap one and the page opens right here with its pictures and words, so you never have to leave Tavo. You can also paste any link into the link field and tap 🌐 Page view, use + → Preview a link, or tap Preview on a web-search result. Tap a picture to see it full screen; tick the circle in its corner to select it, then Save pictures keeps them in Saved Previews (the whole page is remembered under Recent pages). Nothing on the page runs, and ads, trackers and banners are never loaded. Image Chest galleries are read from the list the page keeps inside itself, so the whole gallery shows, 80 pictures at a time. If a page only shows its pictures with JavaScript, Page view says so — a free Tavily key can read those pages for you.

A green bar tells you how many items were hidden; tap Show all to see everything (links are never clickable there). In Found images, tap Show hidden promo to bring those pictures back.
runtime.helpSearchB: In Quick Lookup → Search you can save a Brave key and/or a free Tavily key. Keys stay on this device; only the words you search for (or, when Tavily reads a page, the link) are sent.

releaseNotes.2_26_3:
## Version 2.26.3

More control over what Image Preview keeps on your phone, a Page view fix for gallery sites, plus fixes from a full stress test.

- **Storage manager**: a new screen (chat sidebar, or the monkey's Look window) shows what Image Preview stores, in plain words: saved previews, pins, Recycle Bin, temporary files, page history, lookup history, search keys, appearance and games. Each part explains what it is, why it is needed and what happens if you delete it. Every clean-up shows exactly what will go first, and emptying the Recycle Bin needs an extra tick because it cannot be undone. Nothing outside Image Preview is ever read or deleted.
- **Leftover temporary files fixed**: pages opened with Page view left temporary files behind if the app closed at the wrong moment, and the old clean-up never recognised them. Interrupted downloads and a failed "Save to device" could also leave copies. All of these are now cleaned up, but only when they are provably old and never while in use.
- **Text size**: the monkey's Look window has a text size slider (85% to 130%) with a preview and a default-size button.
- **Background motion**: Static (default), Subtle, Enhanced or Off. Static keeps the panel still, your phone's "reduce motion" setting is always respected, and nothing animates while the panel is closed.
- **Page view**: pictures that sites hide behind lazy-loading can now be found, and a page with a "load more" button now tells you that only its first pictures are shown.
- **Page view and Image Chest**: an Image Chest link used to show only one picture. The site sends its pictures as data inside the page, not as ordinary images, so only the preview picture was found. Page view now reads that list and shows the whole gallery, 80 pictures at a time with a "Show more" button. Other sites are read as before.
- **Page view saved copies**: a page you opened with an older version is read again once, so an old one-picture copy no longer hides pictures that are found now. If the page cannot be reached, the old copy is still shown.
- **Page view and JavaScript pages**: when a page only gives its preview picture, Page view now says so (and asks Tavily if you saved a key). It also tells you when some pictures could not load.
- **Warmer look**: softer ivory text, plus one shared set of colours for the new screens.
